faq.a: You choose the emergency keywords (gas smell, carbon monoxide, flooding, no heat with a baby at home). If there may be danger to life, the caller is told to hang up and call 911 first. Otherwise you get an URGENT email right away. On the Business plan, we can set up urgent night calls to go through to your on-call tech, on request.

faq.q: Does it work with Jobber, Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan?
faq.a: Booking into Google Calendar (free) or Calendly (with your own paid Calendly plan) is included. So is 1 Zapier link (Zapier is an app that connects apps) to send leads to other tools, such as Housecall Pro or GoHighLevel. On the Business plan, we can also set up a direct link to Jobber or HubSpot for you, on request. For ServiceTitan, ask us first.

included_items: 1 new US phone number for your AI receptionist. You keep your own number; calls you miss are sent to the new one.
Collects job details: name, callback number, service address/ZIP, job type, urgency, preferred time
Booking into 1 calendar: Google Calendar (free) or Calendly (needs your own paid Calendly plan)
Appointment manager: callers can check, move or cancel a visit it booked for them just by calling back, and it recognizes returning callers
Answers to up to 25 common questions, your business hours, a nights-and-weekends mode, and emergency words that alert you right away
An email alert for every lead, plus a daily summary email
1 Zapier link (Zapier is an app that connects apps) that sends each new lead and booking to any other tool
Your own online account shows every call, a written copy of each conversation, your bookings and settings.
Every month: we check that it works, update its answers, and make small changes for you, one at a time (up to 1 hour each)
